GetDeploymentConfiguration.name: GetDeploymentConfiguration
GetDeploymentConfiguration.documentation:
Returns the active deployment configuration for a product and delivery option. The active deployment configuration is the configuration from the most recent successful deployment configuration job. The seller that owns the product and buyers entitled to the product can call this operation.

If the product and delivery option have no active deployment configuration, the operation returns a ResourceNotFoundException.

GetDeploymentConfigurationJob.name: GetDeploymentConfigurationJob
GetDeploymentConfigurationJob.documentation:
Returns the details of a deployment configuration job. Only the seller that started the job can call this operation.

If the job doesn't belong to the product and delivery option in the request path, the operation returns a ResourceNotFoundException.

ListDeploymentConfigurationJobs.name: ListDeploymentConfigurationJobs
ListDeploymentConfigurationJobs.documentation:
Lists the deployment configuration jobs that you started for a product and delivery option, ordered from newest to oldest. Results are paginated. Use the nextToken parameter to retrieve additional results.

If you haven't started any jobs for the product and delivery option, the operation returns an empty jobs list.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Lists all tags that have been added to a resource.

PutDeploymentParameter.name: PutDeploymentParameter
PutDeploymentParameter.documentation: Creates or updates a deployment parameter and is targeted by catalog and agreementId.

StartDeploymentConfigurationJob.name: StartDeploymentConfigurationJob
StartDeploymentConfigurationJob.documentation:
Starts a job that publishes a deployment configuration for a product and delivery option. The job runs asynchronously. Use GetDeploymentConfigurationJob to track its status. When the job reaches the SUCCEEDED status, its configuration becomes the active deployment configuration for the product and delivery option.

The populated member of configuration must match the deliveryOptionType in the request path.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation: Removes a tag or list of tags from a resource.

A unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure that the operation completes no more than one time. If you retry a request with the same token and the same input, the service returns the original job instead of starting a new one. If you reuse a token with different input, the request fails with a ConflictException.

This field is not required if you're calling using an AWS SDK. Otherwise, a clientToken must be provided with the request.

documentation:
The AWS Marketplace Deployment Service supports the Quick Launch experience, which is a deployment option for software as a service (SaaS) products. Quick Launch simplifies and reduces the time, resources, and steps required to configure, deploy, and launch a product. The AWS Marketplace Deployment Service provides sellers with a secure method for passing deployment parameters, such as API keys and external IDs, to buyers during the Quick Launch experience.

You can also use the AWS Marketplace Deployment Service to publish deployment configurations. A deployment configuration defines how buyers access a product's delivery option after they subscribe. For example, for the Data as a Service delivery option, it specifies the seller's fulfillment URL.
